newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia growth forecasts conservative - Howard.
newsitem.headline: Australia growth forecasts conservative - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday economic growth forecasts in the 1997/98 (July/June) budget were conservative and achievable.
"The growth forecasts set out in the budget are, in the eyes of most economic forecasters, very conservative and therefore extremely achievable," Howard told Parliament.
The budget released on Tuesday projected year average economic growth of 3.75 percent, up from 3.25 percent in 1996/97. But many economists were forecasting growth around four percent.
The 1996/97 figure was below earlier projections of 3.5 percent, issued in the January mid-year review of economic and budget conditions.
